
[yellow bold]-- DEPRECATION -- rp2040_storage.volt:2[/yellow bold]

Move `chip rp2040` to volt.toml: chip = "rp2040"

 [dim]1 |[/dim] 
 [dim]2 |[/dim] chip rp2040
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: The chip declaration will move to volt.toml in a future version.[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE WARNING -- rp2040_storage.volt:3[/yellow bold]

GP25 is the onboard LED on Pico. On Pico W, GP25 is used for WiFi SPI — not available as GPIO.

 [dim]2 |[/dim] chip rp2040
 [dim]3 |[/dim] hardware { pin led: Output = 25 }
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]               ^^^[/yellow]


[yellow bold]-- UNSAVED STORAGE -- rp2040_storage.volt:4[/yellow bold]

Storage variable `boot_count` is never saved, so it resets to its default on every boot.

 [dim]3 |[/dim] hardware { pin led: Output = 25 }
 [dim]4 |[/dim] storage boot_count: int = 0
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^^^^^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: Call `storage.save("boot_count", boot_count)` after changing it.[/cyan]
